sanitized_sql: SELECT COUNT("public"."client"."client_id") FROM "public"."client" INNER JOIN "public"."disp" ON "public"."client"."client_id" = "public"."disp"."client_id" INNER JOIN "public"."account" ON "public"."disp"."account_id" = "public"."account"."account_id" WHERE "public"."account"."frequency" = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND "public"."disp"."type" = 'OWNER'
